record.question: Which Union Ministry has recently launched the 'Know Your Rights' portal?
record.explanation: Answer D: Civil Aviation. The Ministry of Civil Aviation launched DGCA's Know Your Rights portal on 9 September 2014 to explain air-passenger rights. The original ministry release identifies the launch and minister. Historical/source note: Recent relative to January 2015; this is the aviation passenger-rights portal. Reference: https://www.pib.gov.in/newsite/PrintRelease.aspx?lang=2&reg=48&relid=109481. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical facts are anchored to the original exam; no matching examiner key is asserted.
